headline: 10月6日影剧速览：挖掘者领跑，魔女嘉莉首播
summary: 本周电影市场由《挖掘者》《不存在的罪人》《误杀瞒天记3》等热作带动；剧集方面，《魔女嘉莉》与《乌鸦学园》《Mayday》《库比蒂诺》《暗潮之下》本周首播，《侠探杰克》《母狮》《绿灯军团》持续热播。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《挖掘者》《不存在的罪人》《误杀瞒天记3》等表现亮眼。
industryHighlights.en: Film highlights: The Digger, The Sinner of Nonexistence, Drishyam 3, and more draw attention.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧首播：《乌鸦学园》《魔女嘉莉》《Mayday》《库比蒂诺》《暗潮之下》本周上线。
industryHighlights.en: New TV premieres: Raven Academy, Carrie, Mayday, Cupertino, and Under the Tide arrive this week.

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧：《侠探杰克》《母狮》《绿灯军团》《无职转生》《末日地堡》热度延续。
industryHighlights.en: Popular TV: Jack Reacher, Lioness, Lanterns, Mushoku Tensei, and Silo keep momentum.

industryHighlights.text: 待映电影：《猫鼬》《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》《街头霸王》等受期待。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films: Mongoose, Avengers 5, Dune 3, Street Fighter, and more are anticipated.

headlineEn: Oct 6 Film & TV Digest: The Digger Leads, Carrie Premieres
summaryEn: This week's film market is led by The Digger, The Sinner of Nonexistence, and Drishyam 3; on TV, Carrie, Raven Academy, Mayday, Cupertino, and Under the Tide premiere this week, while Jack Reacher, Lioness, and Lanterns stay hot.
